method.counter_method: slope between N and N/2 operations
method.note: Instruction count is the decision metric. Each ordinary comparison uses the median of three independent repetitions. The final lazy-error-list ablation was additionally checked as an interleaved A/B against a separately built scratch twin so the live tree was never rewound.

bearer_authentication.definition: eight realistic request headers; built-in BearerTokenBackend with a synchronous verifier
bearer_authentication.implementation: scan the native lazy header block for one non-duplicate Bearer credential and guard ordinary verifier results before inspect.isawaitable

fixed_native_policy_dispatch.definition: a stateless first-class HttpPolicy whose ingress and egress are owned by the native server
fixed_native_policy_dispatch.implementation: select the plain dispatcher when the compiled native policy has no activation, post-auth, or dynamic-always work; portable ASGI and refused native descriptors delegate before effects

native_return_validation.definition: one path-bound handler returning dict[str, Any] under a compiled response contract
native_return_validation.implementation: return an unchanged mapping by identity when the native dict plan's child opcode is Any; the final combined samples also include the scalar-activation reductions reported below

native_scalar_activation.definition: one int path parameter converted by the startup-compiled native activation plan
native_scalar_activation.implementation: return the user coroutine directly to the dispatcher, call the activation loop without temporary argument/result tuples, and allocate its error list only after a conversion fails

retained_security_work.decision: retain the legacy cookie/token/HMAC work; its cost is real security processing rather than dispatcher scaffolding
